trial_court: Ms. Deepakshi Rana, Ld. MM (Mahila Court− No.3), Shahdara, CT No. 2510/20
case_name: Sh. Suresh Chand vs Ms. Arti @ Bharti

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: S/o Late Sh. Kundan Lal, husband

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Appellant's appeal against the impugned order dated 22.12.2020 passed by Ms. Deepakshi Rana, Ld. MM (Mahila Court− No.3), Shahdara, in CT No. 2510/20.

legal_principles.principle: The purpose of PWDV Act 2005 cannot be ignored by a sleight of statutory interpretation.
legal_principles.held: Both sets of legislations have to be harmoniously construed.
cited_cases: Smt. S. Vanitha vs. The Deputy Commissioner, Bengaluru Urban District & Ors., (2020) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: The right of a woman to secure a residence order in respect of a shared household cannot be defeated by the simple expedient of securing an order of eviction.
legal_principles.held: Hence, the right of a woman to secure a residence order...cannot be defeated...
cited_cases: Smt. S. Vanitha vs. The Deputy Commissioner, Bengaluru Urban District & Ors., (2020) X SCC Y

outcome.final_order: The impugned order dated 22.12.2020 passed by Ms. Deepakshi Rana, Ld. MM (Mahila Court− No.3), Shahdara, in CT No. 2510/20 is upheld.
